episodes.gist: He covers a report from what he calls an ADL subsidiary labeling Christ is King antisemitic, defending the phrase as the core of Christianity, arguing the authors have no standing to define it, and challenging Daily Wire figures to debate.

episodes.h: TRUMP ATTACKS MASSIE??? Trump Threatens To PRIMARY Rep. Massie Over CR Bill
episodes.gist: He covers Trump's call to primary Rep. Thomas Massie over the clean spending bill, arguing it fits a pattern of moves for Israel since Massie is its lone Republican critic, and that Republicans always posture and then capitulate.

episodes.h: ANTISEMITES DEPORTED??? Trump Admin DEPORTS Palestinian Protester
episodes.gist: He covers the arrest of Columbia graduate Mahmoud Khalil and the $400 million funding cut, arguing the administration was installed by Israel, and responds to the backlash over Candace Owens, Ian Carroll and Andrew Tate on Epstein and Jews.

episodes.h: IAN CARROLL REDPILLS JOE ROGAN??? Mass Awakening As Israel Redpill Goes Mainstream
episodes.gist: He argues Trump's reining in of Musk's DOGE and reversals on tariffs and deportations confirm his predictions, and welcomes Candace Owens, Ian Carroll and Andrew Tate on major podcasts as a mass awakening on Israel.

episodes.h: TRUMP TO DESTROY GAZA??? Trump VOWS To KILL EVERYONE In Gaza
episodes.gist: He covers Trump's threat over Gaza as the ceasefire collapses, arguing Israel never agreed to a permanent ceasefire and is dragging the US toward a wider war, then the Supreme Court's 5-4 foreign aid ruling, which he says shows Trump has little real power.

episodes.h: Trump's Address to Joint Session of Congress
episodes.gist: In live coverage of Trump's address to Congress, he reacts to the speech, calling it long, monotonous and recycled, dominated by DOGE and tax cuts with little on immigration, and says he is losing support for the agenda.

episodes.h: GAZA WAR RETURNS??? Ceasefire COLLAPSES After Israel VIOLATES DEAL
episodes.gist: He argues Vivek Ramaswamy is an anchor baby and that MAGA left him, not the reverse, then covers the Gaza ceasefire's collapse, arguing Israel never agreed to a permanent ceasefire and waited for a friendly Trump government.

episodes.h: TRUMP BTFOS ZELENSKY??? Mineral Deal SCUTTLED After Zelensky BACKTALKS Trump
episodes.gist: He covers the Trump-Zelensky Oval Office blow-up that scuttled the minerals deal, which he welcomes, arguing the deal would have entrenched the US in Ukraine and that the war was unwinnable.

episodes.h: EPSTEIN FILE DUMP??? Trump Admin BOTCHES Rollout Of Epstein Files
episodes.gist: He attacks the House budget resolution's Medicaid cuts, calling Mike Johnson a Paul Ryan clone, then covers the botched Epstein files release, saying the files implicate Israel and the Jewish lobby, which both parties protect.

episodes.h: VIVEK FOR GOVERNOR??? Anti-American SCAMMER USURPS MAGA Movement
episodes.gist: He argues Trump's $5 million gold card contradicts the movement's premise and serves capital's demand for immigration, then covers Vivek Ramaswamy's Ohio run, calling Trump's endorsement the death of MAGA and rejecting civic nationalism.

episodes.h: UKRAINE MINERAL DEAL??? Trump ACQUIRES Ukraine's Resources
episodes.gist: He argues the Ukraine mineral deal rebrands aid and deepens US entrenchment in a war he says is already lost, then covers the AfD's second-place finish in Germany, urging the far right to stop voting for conservative parties.

episodes.h: MILEI CRYPTO RUGPULL??? Argentine President SCAMS $100 million With Libra
episodes.gist: He covers the end of Haitian TPS, arguing executive orders mean nothing unless enforced and that deportation is only about 600 criminals a day, then Milei's Libra coin scandal, calling Milei an intelligence-backed figure tied to Chabad.

episodes.h: TRUMP ATTACKS ZELENSKY??? Trump B*TCH SLAPS Ukraine's President In EPIC POST
episodes.gist: He argues Musk and tech tycoons have turned the country into an oligarchy, calls IVF immoral and a sin Republicans have embraced, and covers Trump's post calling Zelensky a dictator, saying putting Zelensky in his place was overdue.

episodes.h: DOGE CUTS SOCIAL SECURITY??? Elon Moves Into SSA For MASSIVE CUTS
episodes.gist: He lays out his racial views, saying he wants distinct racial communities and a white enclave, argues DOGE's cuts miss entitlements and defense, and praises the US-Russia talks in Saudi Arabia, urging the US to work with Russia against China.

episodes.h: MASS DEPORTATIONS CANCELLED??? Trump on Track For <1 Million Deportations Total
episodes.gist: He argues Elon Musk and the tech right have displaced Trump's populism, covers a Florida shooting of Israeli tourists by a Jewish man as an example of antisemitism hysteria, and says deportations under 600 a day amount to a scam.

episodes.h: VANCE TRIGGERS EUROPE??? VP Vance Delivers BASED Speech In Munich
episodes.gist: He retells the Balfour Declaration story to argue Jews are a transnational entity that manipulates Western countries into wars, then argues Vance's Munich speech should not be trusted, calling Vance a creation of Peter Thiel's network.

episodes.h: TRUMP-PUTIN SUMMIT??? Trump Calls Putin, PEACE IMMINENT
episodes.gist: He covers Trump's plan to take Gaza and expel Palestinians and the fragile ceasefire, then the Trump-Putin call, arguing a Russian win sets a dangerous precedent and the rare-earth deal is cover for continued aid to Ukraine.

episodes.h: ELONS COUP??? DOGE Overthrows President Trump, Enforces AI Takeover
episodes.gist: He reacts to Elon Musk speaking beside Trump in the Oval Office and argues Silicon Valley, Wall Street and Israel-lobby donors bought Trump's platform, citing Trump's repost of a Wall Street Journal piece backing H-1B visas.

episodes.h: GAZA CEASEFIRE SCUTTLED??? Trump DERAILS Peace, ALL OUT WAR IMMINENT?
episodes.gist: He argues Trump's South Africa order is not a win for white people, noting it also cites the ICJ case against Israel, then covers the collapsing Gaza ceasefire, saying renewed fighting lets Israel provoke Iran and drag in the US.

episodes.h: YE RETURNS??? Ye RECANTS Apology, GOES OFF On Jews, Fat People, Broke People
episodes.gist: He covers Ye's return to X, reading his posts and saying he would back Ye for 2028, and contrasts him with Trump's Netanyahu meeting, which he calls a humiliation ritual, arguing Trump's second term is about efficiency, not sovereignty.

episodes.h: 8 YEAR ANNIVERSARY SPECIAL
episodes.gist: In his eight-year anniversary special, he looks back on his career since 2017, from wearing a MAGA hat in college to his clashes with conservative groups, the costs he says he has paid, and why he is optimistic about the movement.

episodes.h: TRUMPS GAZA FAKEOUT??? Trump WALKS BACK American Gaza Plan
episodes.gist: He argues X is purging the far right in line with government censorship requests, says Trump's order on transgender athletes only caps wokeness, and calls Trump's Gaza takeover proposal a negotiating bomb, not a serious plan.

episodes.h: TRUMP ANNEXES GAZA??? Trump Vows To EXPEL Palestinians And OCCUPY GAZA
episodes.gist: He argues mass deportations were never going to happen, then covers Trump's plan to expel Gazans and annex the strip, saying it vindicates him and serves Israel's Gaza 2035 plan and what he calls a Jewish-billionaire fifth column.

episodes.h: JD VANCE EXPOSED??? Secret History of The Entity Known As JD Vance Revealed
episodes.gist: He argues right-wing influencers and JD Vance were built by a Peter Thiel and Silicon Valley network, then covers the order to deport students who back Hamas, arguing the crackdown on criticism of Israel clears the way for war on Iran.

episodes.h: DC PLANE CRASH??? Airliner COLLIDES With Military Helicopter, Killing Dozens
episodes.gist: He gives his week-two assessment of Trump's second term, saying his main concern is that Israel will use a once-in-a-lifetime opening to push the US into war with Iran, then covers the rescinded federal grant freeze as the administration's first major fumble.

episodes.h: DEEPSEEK TANKS NVIDIA??? COMMUNIST China WINNING AI Race Against The US
episodes.gist: He praises Trump's anti-transgender executive orders but argues they only slow liberalism, and covers China's DeepSeek AI, which he calls a Sputnik moment that exposes America's tech oligarchy and its lack of identity.

episodes.h: COLOMBIA BTFO??? Trump Wins Trade War In 30 Minutes
episodes.gist: He tracks ICE's first-week deportation numbers, arguing Trump's coalition of Silicon Valley, Wall Street and the Israel lobby will cap deportations, then covers Colombia folding to Trump's tariff threat, which he praises as American power.

episodes.h: FOREIGN AID CUTOFF??? Well, Except For Israel, Of Course!
episodes.gist: He argues the system lets Trump deliver border security and the DEI rollback while Silicon Valley and the Israel lobby set limits, then covers the aid freeze exempting Israel and Egypt, saying America First except for Israel means America last.

episodes.h: LIBTARD BISHOP SCOLDS TRUMP??? Resistance Liberal Says LGBT, Illegals FEAR Emperor Trump
episodes.gist: He calls Trump's day-one orders underwhelming and mocks deportation claims, reads coverage of Bishop Budde's sermon as a first-term-style embarrassment, and praises Trump's pick of Michael DiMino, a restraint advocate pro-Israel figures attack.

episodes.h: DEI IS DEAD??? Trump FIRES Every Diversity Hire, Ends Affirmative Action
episodes.gist: He argues colorblind meritocracy is a deliberate influence campaign that would hand elite institutions to imported Chinese and Indian students, then praises Trump's orders ending DEI and affirmative action for contractors as a bright spot.

episodes.h: DEPORTATIONS CANCELLED??? Chicago ICE Raid CANCELLED After Leak
episodes.gist: He argues Trump is insufficient on immigration and Israel, calls the missing Chicago ICE raids the first big disappointment, and says the birthright citizenship order, which he supports, will likely be struck down by the Supreme Court.

episodes.h: The Inauguration of Donald Trump
episodes.gist: In live coverage of Trump's inauguration, he reacts to the ceremony and address, praising the speech's themes but arguing Trump dropped the wall, his cabinet is not America First, and billionaire donors will be the main beneficiaries.

episodes.h: TRUMP ADMIN DAY 1: Executive Order RESTORES Border, 2 Genders, Oil, AND MORE
episodes.gist: He argues Silicon Valley oligarchs now run the country, in the H-1B fight, says Israel has a window to strike Iran as the Gaza ceasefire begins, and calls Trump's day-one orders unimpressive beyond the border and January 6 clemency.

episodes.h: ISRAEL INVADES SYRIA??? Syrian Military DESTROYED In MASSIVE Attack
episodes.gist: He covers Israel's 400-plus airstrikes destroying Syria's military after Assad's fall, calling it Likud remaking the region, then the New Jersey drone mothership claim, which he says is a made-up lie building the case for war with Iran.

episodes.h: DANIEL PENNY ACQUITTED??? Subway HERO Beats Charges Against BLACK MANIAC
episodes.gist: He argues the right has been de-radicalized by memes celebrating mediocre middle-class life, then covers the dismissal of Daniel Penny's manslaughter charge, calling Penny a hero and arguing the case is about race.

episodes.h: SYRIAN WAR DAY 9: HTS Captures Homs, ISIS Rising
episodes.gist: He argues the Antisemitism Awareness Act would force universities to suppress criticism of Israel and that Jewish oligarchs drive US politics, then covers HTS's advance in Syria, calling it al-Qaeda by another name and Likud's plan to dismember neighbors.

episodes.h: HUNTER BIDEN PARDONED??? BASED Biden Pardons Cool Son, Democrats Seething
episodes.gist: He attacks JD Vance's Thanksgiving with mostly Indian relatives and the push for high-skilled Indian and Chinese immigration, then covers Biden's pardon of Hunter, which he supports, arguing the president should be above the law.

episodes.h: SYRIAN CIVIL WAR??? Aleppo SEIZED By TERRORISTS, Israel and Turkey Involved
episodes.gist: He declares victory over the wifejak meme, arguing women want to be mastered and politics is the domain of men, then covers the rebel seizure of Aleppo, calling the rebels al-Qaeda and arguing Turkey, the US and Israel all contributed.

episodes.h: LEBANON WAR ENDS??? Biden Brokers Last Minute CEASEFIRE
episodes.gist: He argues the wifejak trend is simping and part of an effort to neutralize the right's critiques of feminism and race, then covers the Israel-Lebanon ceasefire, saying Israel is only pausing to turn on Iran just as Trump takes office.

episodes.h: WIFEJAK PSYOP EXPOSED??? Male Feminists Are NEUTERING The Right Wing
episodes.gist: He argues the wifejak meme is anti-male virtue signaling and that pro-wife content is astroturfed by tech donors de-radicalizing the right, then covers Trump's day-one tariff threat on Canada and Mexico, which he calls effective.

episodes.h: NETANYAHU UNDER ARREST??? ICC Issues Arrest Warrant, Republicans Call For WAR
episodes.gist: He covers the ICC arrest warrants for Netanyahu and Gallant, arguing Republicans' vow to sanction the court reflects donors like Adelson and AIPAC, then Russia's hypersonic strike, which he says Biden provoked to block Trump's peace.

episodes.h: GAETZ WITHDRAWS FROM AG??? Rep. Gaetz EXITS Battle For Attorney General Appointment
episodes.gist: He covers Matt Gaetz's withdrawal as attorney general nominee, arguing it shows Trump's mandate did not change the GOP, that the Senate will also block mass deportations, and that the Trump movement was only an insufficient first step.

episodes.h: RUSSIA STRIKES BACK??? Russia Planning NUCLEAR ATTACK ON AMERICA IMMINENTLY
episodes.gist: He covers Russia's possible response to Ukraine's use of Western long-range missiles, arguing Biden may be derailing Trump's deal with Putin, then argues Trump will not carry out mass deportations, citing Rand Paul's opposition and donor pressure.

episodes.h: NUCLEAR WAR IMMINENT??? Ukraine BOMBS Russia With US Missiles
episodes.gist: He argues the US is now effectively at war with Russia after Biden allowed Ukraine's long-range strikes inside Russia, though he doubts nuclear war, and covers the hacked Matt Gaetz ethics files, suspecting Gaetz is compromised.
